per.name: Automation one
per.sentence: When a production card moves to Review, for North Kites, if it is a weekday, ask the AI checker to look at it, then tell the card's maker, each in their own way.

ways_note.bell: Always on. The bell is the record.
ways_note.email: Your choice is saved. Email starts when the mail address for this product is set up. Until then it waits in the bell.
